reviewMethod: Text extracted from all 220 physical pages; contents and chapter boundaries cross-checked; 48 selected instructional pages rendered and visually inspected. Physical PDF positions are 1-based. Printed Arabic pages are physical minus 14 for body/index leaves, verified at chapter boundaries. Blank leaves retain their counted printed position, not a claim of a visible folio.

ambiguities.handling: The book uses inverted hammer in an uptrend/reversal context. This track describes observable shape and explains conventional inverted-hammer-after-decline versus shooting-star-after-advance labels; source verified against StockCharts ChartSchool, not treated as a guaranteed signal.
Use explicit reward:risk throughout. Book profit/loss 2:1 means potential gain twice planned downside, rather than risk:reward 2:1. Worked exercises are original and ignore costs as stated.

ambiguities.topic: Historical brokerage, tick-size and account rules
ambiguities.handling: Do not reproduce current-rule claims from 2023 text. Only enduring share/auction/short-risk concepts used. No current account eligibility, settlement or buying-power advice is added.
